items.text: Merrill prepares for an aging advisor force by developing the next generation of advisors through its Advisor Development Program (ADP), which trains new advisors through progressive roles (ADP Client Associate, ADP Financial Solutions Advisor, ADP Financial Advisor) until they graduate to Merrill Core Advisor.
items.quote: After mastering key objectives and pre-determined targets, progress through three roles until you graduate to Merrill Core Advisor.

items.text: The Advisor Development Program culminates in Merrill Core Advisor, upon which the advisor has completed the program and possesses the skills to help clients pursue their financial goals, building the advisor pipeline.
items.quote: Upon progression to Merrill Core FA you have completed the Advisor Development Program and now possess the skills and capabilities to help clients create and implement plans to pursue their financial goals.

items.text: Merrill continues to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers and is driving productivity higher on both newer and existing members of its financial advisers team.
items.quote: We're driving productivity higher on both newer and existing members of our financial advisers team, and we continue to attract talent across both new and experienced advisers.

items.text: Merrill runs a training program that trains people in wealth management, which it views as the key driver to keep improving net new flows, per CFO Alastair Borthwick.
items.quote: it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management, Bank of America, and Merrill, and that's ultimately what we believe we can just keep driving in order to improve the net new flows.

items.text: Merrill adds financial advisors to its sales force through its extensive training program and experienced hiring; approximately one-third of net new households in Q2 2025 were added by newly trained advisors.
items.quote: We also continued to add financial advisors to the sales force in Merrill and the Private Bank through our extensive training program and experienced hiring of advisors. Approximately one-third of net new households in Q2 were added by our newly trained advisors.

items.text: Merrill had 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes "Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State" list, which recognizes advisors born in 1986 or later, reflecting strength in next-generation advisors.
items.quote: Recognized more than any other firm, Merrill had 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes "Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State" list
items.definition: advisors born in 1986 or later with a minimum 4 years as an advisor
